title: Unit Event — Choices for the Future — Episode5 The Path You Choose

meta.Event Outline: Emu continues studying management with the Morinomiya Revue. While leading fulfilling days full of new connections, she learns that a threat is coming to bear on Morinomiya's Kikyogumi troupe.

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI
Harbor

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Hey, did something happen with Emu?

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Yeah, she's been sitting on that bench and staring off into space for a really long time now.

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line:
I'm a little worried. Should we try and go talk to her...?
Huh?
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Emu, there you are.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
KAITO...
What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I've been looking for you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I kept wondering how you were doing after we spoke last, so I've been taking peeks here and there using your phone...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Mind if I sit next to you?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sure, sit here!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm sorry for eavesdropping on your conversation with Byakkomachi.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
I really appreciate you worrying about me.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Are you feeling okay...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Suzu told me that she's really scared...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And I think I kinda understand what she's going through right now. Because I felt the same thing when we were trying to save Phoenix Wonderland...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: They started tearing down the old rides and replacing them with new ones...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And I remember the look on the guests' faces as they watched their favorite rides slowly disappear.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I became so scared of disappointing all the people who'd been coming to the park for a really long time...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Of course...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Change things or keep them the same.
Both end up being scary choices...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What if you tried talking to someone who went through the same experience, Emu...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Someone who went through the same experience?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. When Phoenix Wonderland was in trouble...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Who were the first people that tried to turn things around for the park?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Are you talking about...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Those people...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They must've had to overcome the same sort of fear Byakkomachi is feeling right now, yes?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...
Otori Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: You wish to know what we were thinking as we tried to reestablish Phoenix Wonderland as a viable enterprise?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah...! I wanna know what you guys felt back then!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Weren't you afraid of all the changes that were coming?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wasn't the thought of disappointing everyone really scary? Were you ever worried that you were taking the park down the wrong path...?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: What? Why are you asking us these questions now?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Well, truth be told...
Many of those around us were opposed to our choices.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I'd be lying if I said that we never worried or felt scared.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, really. Some even said that we should scrap the park altogether in order to build something else.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: By that point, Phoenix Wonderland had an established history.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Its reputation was effectively set in stone, which made attracting new demographics a nearly impossible task.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: In other words, starting over from scratch would've been easier.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
But we didn't want to do that.
Even if it meant that the park would change drastically, we didn't want Phoenix Wonderland to disappear.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: And we came up with the best ideas we could to prevent it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You guys were scared...
How did you overcome that and move forward?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: It didn't matter that we were worried or feeling scared. We had to move forward.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Because reality wasn't going to wait for us to get all our ducks in a row.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Right. We definitely didn't have the luxury of time.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We had to come up with as many ideas as we could in a short period and choose the best ones...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Nobody knew what the right answer was.
But...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Our task became to turn our choice into the correct solution.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Turn your choice into the correct solution...?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: That being said...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: You and your friends came along partway through, and sent us on a completely different course.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: True. However, if we had ended up partnering with Riley Entertainment...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We would've stuck with that decision.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Once you've made up your mind, it becomes easier to make scary decisions.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: So, the problem becomes a matter of resolve.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I don't know what's on your mind right now...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: But I'll leave you with this.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll do just fine, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: You and your friends are the reason Phoenix Wonderland is thriving right now.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: So, I'm sure you'll find a solution that will make everyone happy.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Keisuke, Shosuke...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks, you guys!
A few days later
Morinomiya Revue - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Interesting...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: This idea could help us deal with all three problems at once. Ticket prices, member retention and the quality of their performances.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Yes. It's a bold idea, but we should be able to turn it into a presentable proposal after we hammer out all the details.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Woohoo!!

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: There's no telling how Morinomiya's fans are going to react. This may result in even greater backlash...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know how you feel, Suzu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You're scared that you're going to disappoint even more fans.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: If you just keep things as is... If you don't do something, then the thing you really care about is going to vanish someday.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Which is why I think everyone is trying to get past the fear and move forward...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nobody knows what the right answer is...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You just have to turn your choice into the correct solution...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Turning my choice into the correct solution... I like that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Me too! My brothers said that to me.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Thank you, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Would you mind bearing with me for just a bit longer?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Before any ideas are presented to the board, they first need to be approved by the chairman.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: So, in order to convince my grandfather, I'd like to hash out the details with you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, of course!
